sandbox.kind: codex's own sandbox (bubblewrap + seccomp on Linux) under the runner's permission profile
sandbox.network_note: on only behind codex's managed proxy (features.network_proxy) with no allowed domain: the commands get their own network namespace

binary.source: the SDK's own resolution (@openai/codex -> its platform package's vendor/<triple>/bin/codex), passed as codexPathOverride so the preflight runs the same binary

sdk.spawns: `<binary> exec --experimental-json ...`, JSONL over stdout, the prompt on stdin (dist/index.js:178-277)
sdk.auth: the CLI's own login under $CODEX_HOME (default ~/.codex/auth.json); the SDK sets CODEX_API_KEY only when an apiKey option is passed, and none is

limits.note: Codex exposes no turn, tool-call or output-token caps; the wall clock aborts the SDK turn (its signal SIGTERMs the codex process)
